description: Asheville Makes a Plan for Climate Resilience is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by City of Asheville; UNCA's National Environmental Mapping and Applications Center (NEMAC). This western North Carolina city is using the Steps to Resilience to proactively plan for expected climate change impacts. Coverage: North Carolina (2017). The toolkit gives North Carolina as the location, 2017 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
